1.web: I command you therefore before God and the Lord Jesus Christ, who will judge the living and the dead at his appearing and his Kingdom:
1.asv: I chargetheein the sight of God, and of Christ Jesus, who shall judge the living and the dead, and by his appearing and his kingdom:

2.web: preach the word; be urgent in season and out of season; reprove, rebuke, and exhort, with all patience and teaching.
2.asv: preach the word; be urgent in season, out of season; reprove, rebuke, exhort, with all longsuffering and teaching.

3.web: For the time will come when they will not listen to the sound doctrine, but, having itching ears, will heap up for themselves teachers after their own lusts;
3.asv: For the time will come when they will not endure the sound doctrine; but, having itching ears, will heap to themselves teachers after their own lusts;

4.web: and will turn away their ears from the truth, and turn aside to fables.
4.asv: and will turn away their ears from the truth, and turn aside unto fables.

5.web: But you be sober in all things, suffer hardship, do the work of an evangelist, and fulfill your ministry.
5.asv: But be thou sober in all things, suffer hardship, do the work of an evangelist, fulfil thy ministry.

6.web: For I am already being offered, and the time of my departure has come.
6.asv: For I am already being offered, and the time of my departure is come.

7.web: I have fought the good fight. I have finished the course. I have kept the faith.
7.asv: I have fought the good fight, I have finished the course, I have kept the faith:

8.web: From now on, there is stored up for me the crown of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous judge, will give to me on that day; and not to me only, but also to all those who have loved his appearing.
8.asv: henceforth there is laid up for me the crown of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous judge, shall give to me at that day; and not to me only, but also to all them that have loved his appearing.

9.web: Be diligent to come to me soon,
9.asv: Give diligence to come shortly unto me:

10.web: for Demas left me, having loved this present world, and went to Thessalonica; Crescens to Galatia, and Titus to Dalmatia.
10.asv: for Demas forsook me, having loved this present world, and went to Thessalonica; Crescens to Galatia, Titus to Dalmatia.

11.web: Only Luke is with me. Take Mark, and bring him with you, for he is useful to me for service.
11.asv: Only Luke is with me. Take Mark, and bring him with thee; for he is useful to me for ministering.

12.web: But I sent Tychicus to Ephesus.
12.asv: But Tychicus I sent to Ephesus.

13.web: Bring the cloak that I left at Troas with Carpus when you come, and the books, especially the parchments.
13.asv: The cloak that I left at Troas with Carpus, bring when thou comest, and the books, especially the parchments.

14.web: Alexander, the coppersmith, did much evil to me. The Lord will repay him according to his works,
14.asv: Alexander the coppersmith did me much evil: the Lord will render to him according to his works:

15.web: of whom you also must beware; for he greatly opposed our words.
15.asv: of whom do thou also beware; for he greatly withstood our words.

16.web: At my first defense, no one came to help me, but all left me. May it not be held against them.
16.asv: At my first defence no one took my part, but all forsook me: may it not be laid to their account.

17.web: But the Lord stood by me, and strengthened me, that through me the message might be fully proclaimed, and that all the Gentiles might hear; and I was delivered out of the mouth of the lion.
17.asv: But the Lord stood by me, and strengthened me; that through me the message might be fully proclaimed, and that all the Gentiles might hear: and I was delivered out of the mouth of the lion.

18.web: And the Lord will deliver me from every evil work, and will preserve me for his heavenly Kingdom; to whom be the glory forever and ever. Amen.
18.asv: The Lord will deliver me from every evil work, and will save me unto his heavenly kingdom: to whom be the glory for ever and ever. Amen.

19.web: Greet Prisca and Aquila, and the house of Onesiphorus.
19.asv: Salute Prisca and Aquila, and the house of Onesiphorus.

20.web: Erastus remained at Corinth, but I left Trophimus at Miletus sick.
20.asv: Erastus remained at Corinth: but Trophimus I left at Miletus sick.

21.web: Be diligent to come before winter. Eubulus salutes you, as do Pudens, Linus, Claudia, and all the brothers.
21.asv: Give diligence to come before winter. Eubulus saluteth thee, and Pudens, and Linus, and Claudia, and all the brethren.

22.web: The Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Grace be with you. Amen.
22.asv: The Lord be with thy spirit. Grace be with you.
